1.headline: Bombs hit a village in Yemen
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Is the war in Yemen getting worse again?

Yemen is a country in the Middle East. On Saturday, planes dropped bombs on homes in a small village. The village is near Sanaa, the capital city. At least 22 people died. About 30 people were hurt. Most of them were women and children.
A group called the Houthis controls Sanaa. Houthi leaders said Saudi Arabia did it. Saudi Arabia did not answer right away.
In 2022, the two sides stopped fighting for a while. But the fighting started again in July. Since then, many people have lost their homes.
Again, bombs hit a village in Yemen. At least 22 people died.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
예멘의 전쟁이 다시 심해지고 있는 걸까요?
예멘은 중동에 있는 나라입니다. 토요일에 비행기들이 작은 마을의 집들 위로 폭탄을 떨어뜨렸습니다. 그 마을은 수도 사나 근처에 있습니다. 최소 22명이 숨졌습니다. 약 30명이 다쳤습니다. 다친 사람 대부분은 여성과 어린이였습니다.
후티라는 단체가 사나를 장악하고 있습니다. 후티 지도부는 사우디아라비아가 한 일이라고 말했습니다. 사우디아라비아는 바로 답하지 않았습니다.
2022년에 양측은 한동안 싸움을 멈췄습니다. 하지만 7월에 싸움이 다시 시작되었습니다. 그 뒤로 많은 사람이 집을 잃었습니다.
다시 말씀드리면, 예멘의 한 마을에 폭탄이 떨어졌습니다. 최소 22명이 숨졌습니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

2.headline: Airstrikes near Yemen's capital kill at least 22
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Is the war in Yemen getting bigger again?

On Saturday, airstrikes hit homes in a village near Sanaa, the capital of Yemen. An airstrike is an attack from planes in the sky. Health officials said at least 22 people were killed. About 30 others were hurt. Most of them were women and children.

The Houthi group controls Sanaa. Its officials said Saudi Arabia carried out the strikes. Saudi Arabia did not comment right away. One day earlier, the Houthis said 30 people died in strikes on a market in southern Yemen. Each side blamed the other for that attack.

Yemen has had a war for more than ten years. In 2022, the United Nations helped make a truce. A truce is an agreement to stop fighting for a while. But fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis started again in July. The Houthis have attacked Saudi airports and oil sites with missiles and drones.
This news is important because many families are suffering. Since the new fighting began, more than 200,000 people have had to leave their homes.
To sum up, airstrikes near Yemen's capital killed at least 22 people. The Houthis blamed Saudi Arabia for the attack.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
예멘의 전쟁이 다시 커지고 있는 걸까요?
토요일에 예멘의 수도 사나 근처 마을의 주택들이 공습을 받았습니다. 공습은 하늘에서 비행기로 하는 공격입니다. 보건 당국자들은 최소 22명이 숨졌다고 밝혔습니다. 다른 약 30명이 다쳤습니다. 이들 대부분은 여성과 어린이였습니다.
후티 단체가 사나를 장악하고 있습니다. 후티 측 당국자들은 사우디아라비아가 공습을 했다고 말했습니다. 사우디아라비아는 바로 입장을 밝히지 않았습니다. 하루 전에는 예멘 남부의 한 시장에 대한 공습으로 30명이 숨졌다고 후티 측이 밝혔습니다. 그 공격에 대해서는 양측이 서로를 탓했습니다.
예멘은 10년 넘게 전쟁을 겪어 왔습니다. 2022년에 유엔이 휴전 성사를 도왔습니다. 휴전은 한동안 싸움을 멈추기로 하는 합의입니다. 하지만 사우디아라비아와 후티 사이의 싸움이 7월에 다시 시작되었습니다. 후티는 미사일과 드론으로 사우디의 공항과 석유 시설을 공격해 왔습니다.
많은 가족이 고통받고 있기 때문에 이 뉴스는 중요합니다. 새로운 싸움이 시작된 뒤로 20만 명이 넘는 사람이 집을 떠나야 했습니다.
정리하면, 예멘 수도 근처의 공습으로 최소 22명이 숨졌습니다. 후티 측은 이 공격을 두고 사우디아라비아를 탓했습니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

3.headline: Airstrikes near Yemen's capital kill at least 22 people
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
How did a small village near Yemen's capital become the scene of one of the deadliest attacks in months?

On Saturday, airstrikes hit homes in a village near Sanaa, the capital of Yemen. According to health officials from the Houthi group, which controls Sanaa, at least 22 people were killed and about 30 were hurt. Most of the victims were women and children. Later reports said the number of deaths had risen to more than two dozen.

The Houthi officials blamed Saudi Arabia for the strikes. Saudi Arabia did not comment right away, and the numbers could not be checked independently. One day earlier, Houthi officials said 30 people died in strikes on a market in southern Yemen. Each side blamed the other for that attack.

Here is some background. Yemen has suffered from war for more than ten years. In 2022, the United Nations helped arrange a truce. A truce means both sides agree to stop fighting for a while. But fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis started again in July. The Houthis have fired missiles and drones at Saudi airports and oil sites, and Saudi Arabia has answered with airstrikes.

Why does this matter? News reports describe the fighting as a spillover from the wider conflict between the United States and Iran. A spillover means a problem spreads from one place to another. The Houthis are close to Iran. A United Nations migration agency said in October that more than 200,000 people had been forced from their homes since the new fighting began.
To sum up, airstrikes near Yemen's capital killed at least 22 people on Saturday, and the Houthis blamed Saudi Arabia. The attack shows that the truce in Yemen is breaking down.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
예멘 수도 근처의 작은 마을이 어떻게 몇 달 만에 가장 많은 사망자를 낸 공격의 현장이 되었을까요?
토요일에 예멘의 수도 사나 근처 마을의 주택들이 공습을 받았습니다. 사나를 장악한 후티 단체의 보건 당국자들에 따르면 최소 22명이 숨지고 약 30명이 다쳤습니다. 희생자 대부분은 여성과 어린이였습니다. 이후 보도에서는 사망자가 20명대 후반으로 늘었다고 전했습니다.
후티 측 당국자들은 이번 공습을 두고 사우디아라비아를 탓했습니다. 사우디아라비아는 바로 입장을 밝히지 않았고, 피해 숫자는 독립적으로 확인되지 않았습니다. 하루 전에는 예멘 남부의 한 시장이 공습을 받아 30명이 숨졌다고 후티 측이 밝혔습니다. 그 공격에 대해서는 양측이 서로를 탓했습니다.
배경을 살펴보겠습니다. 예멘은 10년 넘게 전쟁으로 고통받아 왔습니다. 2022년에 유엔이 휴전 성사를 도왔습니다. 휴전이란 양측이 한동안 싸움을 멈추기로 합의하는 것을 말합니다. 하지만 사우디아라비아와 후티 사이의 싸움이 7월에 다시 시작되었습니다. 후티는 사우디의 공항과 석유 시설에 미사일과 드론을 쏘았고, 사우디아라비아는 공습으로 대응해 왔습니다.
이 일이 왜 중요할까요? 언론 보도는 이번 싸움을 미국과 이란 사이의 더 큰 분쟁이 번진 것으로 설명합니다. 번진다는 것은 한 곳의 문제가 다른 곳으로 퍼진다는 뜻입니다. 후티는 이란과 가깝습니다. 유엔 이주 기구는 10월에, 새로운 싸움이 시작된 뒤 20만 명이 넘는 사람이 집을 떠나야 했다고 밝혔습니다.
정리하면, 토요일에 예멘 수도 근처에서 공습으로 최소 22명이 숨졌고, 후티 측은 사우디아라비아를 탓했습니다. 이번 공격은 예멘의 휴전이 무너지고 있음을 보여 줍니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

4.headline: Airstrikes near Sanaa kill at least 22; Houthis blame Saudi Arabia
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
Airstrikes on a village outside Yemen's capital have killed at least 22 people, most of them women and children, raising fears that a long-running war is escalating again.

The strikes hit homes on Saturday in a village near Sanaa, according to a spokesman for the health ministry run by the Houthi rebels, who control the capital. He said around 30 others were wounded and accused Saudi Arabia of carrying out the attack. Later reports put the death toll above two dozen, which would make it one of the deadliest attacks since fighting resumed. Saudi Arabia did not immediately comment, and the figures could not be independently verified.
A hospital director in Sanaa told reporters that many victims were still trapped under the rubble, and that some rescuers had been hit as they arrived at the scene.

The violence came just a day after Houthi officials said 30 people had been killed in strikes on a market in southern Yemen. The Houthis and Yemen's Saudi-backed military blamed each other for that incident.

Yemen's conflict has dragged on for twelve years. A United Nations-brokered truce in 2022 brought a period of relative calm, but fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-aligned Houthis broke out again in July. Since then, the Houthis have launched missiles and drones at Saudi airports and oil facilities, while Riyadh has responded with airstrikes in support of its Yemeni allies.

News reports describe the renewed fighting as a spillover from the broader confrontation between the United States and Iran. The International Organization for Migration said in October that more than 200,000 people had been displaced since the latest round of fighting began.
To sum up, airstrikes near Sanaa killed at least 22 people on Saturday, the Houthis blamed Saudi Arabia, and the attack suggests that the 2022 truce is close to collapse.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
예멘 수도 외곽의 한 마을이 공습을 받아 최소 22명이 숨졌고, 그 대부분이 여성과 어린이였습니다. 오래 이어진 전쟁이 다시 격화하고 있다는 우려가 커지고 있습니다.

수도를 장악한 후티 반군이 운영하는 보건부의 대변인에 따르면, 토요일에 사나 근처 마을의 주택들이 공습을 받았습니다. 대변인은 다른 약 30명이 다쳤다고 말했고, 사우디아라비아가 공격을 감행했다고 비난했습니다. 이후 보도에서는 사망자가 20명대 후반으로 늘었다고 전해, 싸움이 재개된 이후 가장 많은 사망자를 낸 공격 가운데 하나가 될 것으로 보입니다. 사우디아라비아는 즉각 입장을 내지 않았고, 이 수치는 독립적으로 확인되지 않았습니다.
사나의 한 병원장은 기자들에게 많은 희생자가 아직 잔해 아래에 갇혀 있으며, 일부 구조대원은 현장에 도착하자마자 공격을 받았다고 말했습니다.
이번 폭력 사태는 후티 당국자들이 예멘 남부의 한 시장에 대한 공습으로 30명이 숨졌다고 밝힌 지 불과 하루 만에 일어났습니다. 후티와 사우디의 지원을 받는 예멘 정부군은 그 사건을 두고 서로를 탓했습니다.
예멘 분쟁은 12년째 이어지고 있습니다. 2022년 유엔 중재로 맺어진 휴전으로 비교적 평온한 시기가 찾아왔지만, 사우디아라비아와 이란 편에 선 후티 사이의 싸움이 7월에 다시 터졌습니다. 그 뒤로 후티는 사우디의 공항과 석유 시설에 미사일과 드론을 발사했고, 사우디 정부는 예멘 내 동맹 세력을 지원하며 공습으로 대응해 왔습니다.
언론 보도는 다시 시작된 싸움을 미국과 이란 사이의 더 큰 대립이 번진 것으로 설명합니다. 국제이주기구는 10월에, 최근 싸움이 시작된 뒤 20만 명이 넘는 사람이 피란했다고 밝혔습니다.
정리하면, 토요일 사나 근처의 공습으로 최소 22명이 숨졌고, 후티 측은 사우디아라비아를 탓했습니다. 이번 공격은 2022년 휴전이 붕괴 직전이라는 것을 보여 줍니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

5.headline: Deadly strikes near Sanaa deepen fears for Yemen's fragile truce
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
In one of the bloodiest single episodes since hostilities flared up again this summer, airstrikes on a village on the outskirts of Yemen's capital have left at least 22 people dead.

According to a spokesman for the Houthi-run health ministry, the strikes tore through homes near Sanaa on Saturday, wounding some 30 others, the majority of them women and children. Subsequent reports put the toll at more than two dozen. The Houthis, who have held the capital for over a decade, laid the blame squarely on Saudi Arabia. Riyadh offered no immediate response, and the figures could not be independently corroborated.

The director of a Sanaa hospital painted a grim picture, saying many victims remained trapped beneath the rubble and that follow-up strikes had landed just as rescuers reached the scene, claiming the lives of some first responders.

The bloodshed came hard on the heels of another deadly incident. A day earlier, Houthi officials reported that 30 people had been killed when strikes hit a market in southern Yemen, an attack for which the rebels and the country's Saudi-backed armed forces traded blame.

Yemen's war, now in its twelfth year, had been largely on hold since a United Nations-brokered truce in 2022. That fragile calm unraveled in July, when fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-aligned Houthis erupted anew. The rebels have since targeted Saudi airports and oil installations with missiles and drones, while the kingdom has mounted airstrikes in support of its Yemeni allies. All of this has unfolded in what was already the poorest country in the Arab world, where millions of families depend on outside aid simply to get by.

News reports have characterized the escalation as a spillover from the wider standoff between Washington and Tehran, and its human cost is mounting. The International Organization for Migration said in October that more than 200,000 people had been uprooted since the latest round of fighting began.
To sum up, Saturday's strikes near Sanaa killed at least 22 people, the Houthis pinned the attack on Saudi Arabia, and the violence underscores how close the 2022 truce is to falling apart entirely.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
올여름 교전이 다시 불붙은 이후 단일 사건으로는 가장 참혹한 사례 가운데 하나로, 예멘 수도 외곽의 한 마을이 공습을 받아 최소 22명이 숨졌습니다.

후티가 운영하는 보건부 대변인에 따르면, 토요일 공습이 사나 근처의 주택들을 휩쓸었고 다른 약 30명이 다쳤으며 그 대다수가 여성과 어린이였습니다. 이후 보도에서는 사망자가 20명대 후반에 이른다고 전했습니다. 10년 넘게 수도를 장악해 온 후티는 책임을 전적으로 사우디아라비아에 돌렸습니다. 사우디 정부는 즉각 반응하지 않았고, 이 수치는 독립적으로 확인되지 않았습니다.
사나의 한 병원장은 암울한 상황을 전하며, 많은 희생자가 여전히 잔해 아래에 갇혀 있고 구조대원들이 현장에 도착하는 순간 후속 공습이 떨어져 일부 응급 대원이 목숨을 잃었다고 말했습니다.
이번 유혈 사태는 또 다른 참사에 바로 뒤이어 일어났습니다. 하루 전 후티 당국자들은 예멘 남부의 한 시장이 공습을 받아 30명이 숨졌다고 밝혔는데, 이 공격을 두고 반군과 사우디의 지원을 받는 예멘 정부군이 서로 책임을 떠넘겼습니다.

들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

1.headline: Ronaldo stops playing for Portugal
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
Who has scored the most goals for a national team? It is Cristiano Ronaldo.
Ronaldo is a famous soccer player from Portugal. He is 41 years old. On Thursday, he made a video. He said he will stop playing for Portugal.
He played for his country for 23 years. He played 234 games. He scored 146 goals. Both numbers are world records.
Ronaldo said it was not an easy decision. But he will still play for his club team in Saudi Arabia. He wants to score 1,000 goals in his career. He has 985 now.
Again, Ronaldo will not play for Portugal anymore.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
국가대표팀에서 가장 많은 골을 넣은 사람은 누구일까요? 바로 크리스티아누 호날두입니다.

2.headline: Ronaldo says goodbye to Portugal's national team
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
After 23 years, one of the most famous shirts in soccer is going back to Portugal.

Cristiano Ronaldo, the 41-year-old soccer star, has retired from international soccer. That means he will not play for Portugal's national team anymore. He shared the news in a long video on social media on Thursday. He said he was giving back his number 7 shirt.

Ronaldo first played for Portugal in 2003. He played 234 games and scored 146 goals. No man in history has played more games or scored more goals for a national team. He also helped Portugal win its first big trophy, Euro 2016.

Ronaldo said it was not an easy decision. He said some decisions are made with the heart, not only with the head. Portugal's soccer federation called him the greatest player of all time and plans a special event for him.
Did you know? Ronaldo is still playing for a club in Saudi Arabia. He has scored 985 goals in his career, and he wants to reach 1,000.
To sum up, Ronaldo has said goodbye to Portugal's national team after 23 years and many records.
Thank you for listening.

3.headline: Ronaldo retires from Portugal's national team
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
What do you do when you have broken almost every record there is? For Cristiano Ronaldo, the answer is to say goodbye.

Ronaldo, the 41-year-old Portuguese star, has announced his retirement from international soccer. In other words, he will no longer play for Portugal's national team. He made the announcement on Thursday in a long video on social media. In it, he said the time had come to hand back the number 7 shirt he had worn for 23 years.

His numbers are amazing. Ronaldo played 234 games for Portugal and scored 146 goals. Both are all-time records for international soccer. He was also the first man to score at six World Cups. Under his leadership, Portugal won its first major trophy, the European Championship in 2016, and later two Nations League titles.

Ronaldo said it was not an easy decision. He explained that some decisions are made not only with the head, but also with the heart. He thanked his family, his teammates and the Portuguese people. Portugal's soccer federation said many people see him as the greatest player of all time, and it plans a tribute, which is a special event to honor him.
Did you know? Ronaldo is not stopping completely. He still plays for Al-Nassr, a club in Saudi Arabia, and he is chasing a huge goal: 1,000 career goals. He has 985 so far.
This story matters to fans around the world because it marks the end of an era, a long and important period in soccer history.
To sum up, Cristiano Ronaldo has retired from Portugal's national team after 23 years, 234 games and 146 goals.
Thank you for listening.

4.headline: Cristiano Ronaldo ends his record-breaking career with Portugal
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
The most prolific goal scorer in the history of international men's soccer is hanging up his national team jersey.

Cristiano Ronaldo, now 41, announced on Thursday that he is retiring from international play, bringing an end to a 23-year career with Portugal. In a lengthy video posted on social media, he told the Portuguese people that the day had come for him to hand back the number 7 shirt, adding that he had never felt it belonged to him alone.

Ronaldo leaves with a remarkable list of achievements. He made 234 appearances and scored 146 goals for his country, both all-time records in men's international soccer. He was the first man to score at six World Cups and the first to reach 200 international appearances. He captained Portugal to its first major title at the European Championship in 2016, and the team went on to win the Nations League in 2019 and 2025.

Describing the moment, Ronaldo said it was not an easy decision, because some choices are made with the heart as well as the head. Portugal's football federation expressed deep gratitude, said that for many people he is the greatest player of all time, and announced plans for a tribute.
His retirement comes only weeks after Argentina's Lionel Messi also finished his international career, closing a remarkable chapter in which the two stars dominated the sport for nearly two decades.

Ronaldo is not leaving the game entirely, however. He is expected to finish his playing days at the end of this season with Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia, and he is still pursuing a milestone of 1,000 career goals. He currently has 985.
To sum up, Cristiano Ronaldo has retired from Portugal's national team after 234 games and 146 goals, both world records.
Thank you for listening.

5.headline: Ronaldo bows out of international football, ending a record-shattering era
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
After 23 years, six World Cups and more international goals than any man who has ever played the game, Cristiano Ronaldo has finally called time on his career with Portugal.

The 41-year-old forward broke the news on Thursday in an emotional video posted to social media, telling his compatriots that the day had come to hand back the number 7 shirt. He stressed that he had never regarded it as his alone, describing the decision as anything but easy, since some choices are made not only with the head but with the heart.

The statistics speak for themselves. Ronaldo bows out with 234 caps and 146 goals for his country, both all-time records in the men's international game. He was the first man to find the net at six World Cups and the first to reach the milestone of 200 international appearances. As captain, he steered Portugal to its first major trophy at the 2016 European Championship, a triumph later followed by Nations League titles in 2019 and 2025. Before his debut in 2003, Portugal had qualified for the World Cup only three times, a measure of how dramatically he transformed the team's fortunes.

Tributes have poured in. Portugal's football federation voiced deep gratitude and immense admiration, declaring that for many he is the greatest player of all time, and it is planning a formal tribute to mark his departure.

The announcement arrives just weeks after Lionel Messi drew the curtain on his own career with Argentina, effectively closing the book on a rivalry that defined a generation of the sport and kept fans enthralled for the better part of two decades.

Still, Ronaldo is not hanging up his boots just yet. He is expected to see out the season with Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia before retiring altogether, and he remains in hot pursuit of a staggering personal landmark: 1,000 career goals. He currently sits on 985.

To sum up, Cristiano Ronaldo has stepped away from Portugal's national team as the record holder for both appearances and goals, bringing the curtain down on one of football's most celebrated international careers.
Thank you for listening.

1.headline: A Korean cycling YouTuber dies in Bolivia
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
This man rode his bike through 36 countries.
His name was Cho Jin-woo. He was a Korean travel YouTuber. He was 33 years old. He made videos about his bike trips around the world.

On Wednesday, he was riding his bike in Bolivia. Bolivia is a country in South America. Early in the morning, a big truck hit him. He died. The driver did not stop. But the police caught him a few hours later.
His family is going to Bolivia now. They want to bring him home to Korea.
Again, a Korean travel YouTuber died in Bolivia. A truck hit him on his bike.
Thank you for listening.

다시 말씀드리면, 한국의 여행 유튜버가 볼리비아에서 숨졌습니다. 자전거를 타던 그를 트럭이 쳤습니다.
들어 주셔서 감사합니다.

3.headline: Korean cycling YouTuber 'Jin's Travel' dies in Bolivia hit-and-run
p: Good morning. This is your morning news in English.
He crossed 36 countries in Europe on two wheels, but his journey ended suddenly on a road in South America.

South Korean travel YouTuber Cho Jin-woo, known online as "Jin's Travel," has died in Bolivia. He was 33. According to news reports, Cho was riding his bicycle early on Wednesday morning in El Alto, a city in Bolivia, when a large cargo truck struck him.

It was a hit-and-run. A hit-and-run means a driver hits someone and leaves without stopping to help. Police arrested the truck driver several hours later. He told police that he had not seen Cho on his bicycle. A breath test showed no alcohol in his body.

Cho opened his YouTube channel in 2020 and shared videos of his cycling trips around the world. The channel has about 66,000 subscribers. His biggest trip so far lasted 523 days, from 2022 to 2023. During that time, he rode about 23,200 kilometers through 36 European countries.

In March this year, he started a new trip across Latin America, beginning in Guatemala. Bolivia was one of the stops. His last video, posted in September, showed him next to his bicycle, which carried a Korean flag, on a mountain road in Peru.

Cho's older brother wrote on Instagram that the whole family was leaving for Bolivia right away. He asked for support as they work to bring Cho safely back to Korea, and he thanked people for their kind words.
To sum up, a Korean YouTuber who cycled across many countries was killed in a hit-and-run in Bolivia, and his family is now traveling there to bring him home.
Thank you for listening.
tr: 좋은 아침입니다. 영어로 듣는 아침 뉴스입니다.
그는 자전거로 유럽 36개 나라를 지났지만, 그의 여정은 남아메리카의 한 도로에서 갑자기 끝나고 말았습니다.
온라인에서 '진스 트래블'로 알려진 한국의 여행 유튜버 조진우 씨가 볼리비아에서 숨졌습니다. 향년 33세입니다. 보도에 따르면 조 씨는 수요일 이른 아침 볼리비아의 도시 엘알토에서 자전거를 타던 중 대형 화물 트럭에 치였습니다.
뺑소니 사고였습니다. 뺑소니란 운전자가 사람을 치고도 멈춰서 돕지 않고 떠나는 것을 말합니다. 경찰은 몇 시간 뒤 트럭 운전자를 체포했습니다. 운전자는 경찰에 자전거를 탄 조 씨를 보지 못했다고 말했습니다. 음주 측정 결과 몸에서 알코올은 나오지 않았습니다.
조 씨는 2020년에 유튜브 채널을 열고 세계 곳곳을 자전거로 여행하는 영상을 올렸습니다. 채널 구독자는 약 6만 6천 명입니다. 지금까지 가장 긴 여행은 2022년부터 2023년까지 523일 동안 이어졌습니다. 그 기간에 그는 유럽 36개 나라를 지나 약 2만 3,200킬로미터를 달렸습니다.
올해 3월, 그는 과테말라에서 출발해 중남미를 가로지르는 새 여행을 시작했습니다. 볼리비아는 그 경유지 가운데 하나였습니다. 9월에 올라온 그의 마지막 영상에는 페루의 산길에서 태극기를 단 자전거 옆에 선 그의 모습이 담겼습니다.
조 씨의 형은 인스타그램에 가족 모두가 곧바로 볼리비아로 떠난다고 썼습니다. 그는 가족이 조 씨를 무사히 한국으로 데려올 수 있도록 응원해 달라고 부탁했고, 따뜻한 위로의 말에 감사를 전했습니다.
정리하면, 자전거로 많은 나라를 누빈 한국의 유튜버가 볼리비아에서 뺑소니 사고로 숨졌고, 그의 가족은 그를 집으로 데려오기 위해 지금 그곳으로 가고 있습니다.

4.headline: Korean travel YouTuber killed in hit-and-run during Bolivia cycling trip
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
A South Korean YouTuber who spent more than a year cycling across Europe has been killed in a hit-and-run in Bolivia, partway through another long-distance journey.

Cho Jin-woo, who ran the travel channel "Jin's Travel," died on Wednesday at the age of 33. According to news reports, he was cycling in the Bolivian city of El Alto early in the morning when he was struck by a large cargo truck.

The driver fled the scene but was taken into custody by police several hours later. He reportedly told officers that he had not noticed Cho on his bicycle, and a breathalyzer test found no alcohol in his system.

Cho launched his YouTube channel in 2020 and built a following of about 66,000 subscribers by documenting his cycling adventures. His best-known trip lasted 523 days, from March 2022 to September 2023, during which he covered roughly 23,200 kilometers across 36 European countries.

Bolivia was one stop on his current journey through Latin America, which began in Guatemala in March. His final upload, posted in late September, showed him standing beside his bicycle, decorated with a South Korean flag, on a road in the Peruvian Andes.

In a message to subscribers on Instagram, Cho's older brother said the entire family was preparing to leave for Bolivia immediately. He asked for support as they work to bring his brother safely back to Korea, and thanked people for their words of comfort.

5.headline: Cycling YouTuber 'Jin's Travel' killed in Bolivian hit-and-run
p: Good morning, and welcome to your morning news in English.
A South Korean adventurer who pedaled his way across three dozen European countries has lost his life on a highland road in Bolivia, cut down in a hit-and-run midway through his latest odyssey.

Cho Jin-woo, the 33-year-old creator behind the YouTube channel "Jin's Travel," was killed early on Wednesday in the city of El Alto, according to news reports. He was cycling through the area in the early hours when a large cargo truck slammed into him.
The driver sped off but was apprehended by police several hours later. He is said to have told officers that he simply had not seen the cyclist, and a breathalyzer test turned up no trace of alcohol.

Since setting up his channel in 2020, Cho had amassed roughly 66,000 subscribers with footage of his two-wheeled travels. His signature expedition spanned 523 days between March 2022 and September 2023, a marathon ride of some 23,200 kilometers through 36 countries across Europe.

Bolivia was merely one leg of his ongoing trek through Latin America, which got under way in Guatemala in March. His final video, uploaded in late September, captured him standing alongside his bicycle, a South Korean flag fluttering from it, on a winding road high in the Peruvian Andes.

In a heartfelt message to followers on Instagram, Cho's older brother wrote that the entire family was preparing to depart for Bolivia without delay. He appealed for support as they work to repatriate his brother safely, and expressed gratitude for the outpouring of condolences.

The tragedy unfolded in a city perched beside La Paz at an altitude of more than 4,000 meters, making El Alto one of the loftiest large urban centers on the planet, a rugged backdrop that had featured prominently in the journey his viewers were following so closely.

To sum up, travel YouTuber Cho Jin-woo has died in a hit-and-run in Bolivia, a sudden and sorrowful end to a journey that had captivated tens of thousands of viewers, and his family is now heading there to bring him home.
Thank you for listening.
